scope: V1 Chunked Prefill scheduling, token budget trade-offs, long-prefill threshold and multimodal chunk boundaries.

claims.claim: The V1 optimization guide describes Chunked Prefill as batching smaller portions of long prompts with Decode requests; pending Decode work is prioritized before new Prefill work and long Prefill is split when it does not fit the remaining token budget.
claims.notes: The scheduler also processes existing Running requests before admitting Waiting requests; avoid reducing the entire algorithm to a single decode-first queue.

claims.claim: SchedulerConfig.enable_chunked_prefill allows prefill requests to be chunked based on remaining max_num_batched_tokens; max_num_batched_tokens is a per-iteration token capacity, not a fixed chunk-size parameter.
claims.notes: Some model paths or configurations can disable chunking, including models without KV cache and encoder-decoder restrictions.

claims.claim: The official optimization guide describes smaller token budgets as favoring ITL and larger budgets as allowing more Prefill tokens per batch, potentially improving TTFT and throughput.
claims.notes: Recommendations depend on model size, GPU, workload and SLO; no universal best budget is asserted.

claims.claim: long_prefill_token_threshold can cap the size of a long Prefill chunk when multiple requests are eligible; the adaptive option can floor the effective cap at a fair share of the token budget.
claims.notes: The threshold is ignored when Chunked Prefill is disabled and is not applied when the long request is the only eligible request.

claims.claim: disable_chunked_mm_input can prevent partial scheduling of a multimodal item while allowing surrounding text tokens to be scheduled separately.
claims.notes: Multimodal feature boundaries are model- and processor-dependent.

claims.claim: The chapter's interactive calculator allocates one token per active Decode request and uses the remaining budget for one Prompt; it is a derived teaching model, not a faithful simulation of vLLM's complete scheduler.
claims.locator: Scheduler.schedule token-budget and request scheduling logic
claims.notes: The toy model deliberately omits KV block allocation, Prefix Cache, speculative decode, multimodal input and scheduling order nuances.

claims.claim: The V1 optimization guide states that Chunked Prefill is enabled by default whenever possible.
claims.notes: Model architecture and runtime constraints can disable the feature; inspect the resolved configuration rather than assuming every deployment uses it.
